ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Records user and system activity across the Q-GRID SENTINEL website, including navigation, BLE connections, key rotations, node isolations, settings changes, and forensic exports.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who recorded the activity.

action.description: Short identifier of the activity performed.

details.description: Detailed human-readable description of the website activity.

nodeId.description: Substation node ID associated with the activity (or 'ALL' / 'GLOBAL').

qberAtEvent.description: QBER percentage at the moment the activity occurred.

clientTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string generated on the client.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity record was persisted.

TriggerEvent.title: TriggerEvent
TriggerEvent.description: Records every security trigger event, QBER threshold breach, Eve hardware/UI switch activation, cyberattack injection, and automated mitigation trigger.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user session.

source.description: Source component or hardware channel that initiated the trigger.

nodeName.description: Display name of the affected substation node.

peakQber.description: Peak QBER value (%) observed during the trigger.

thresholdValue.description: Configured QBER_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD (%) when the trigger fired.

anomalyScore.description: Edge AI anomaly probability [0.0 .. 1.0] at trigger time.

autoMitigated.description: Whether automated Kyber-1024 key rotation mitigation was executed.

clientTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string when the trigger occurred.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the trigger was stored.

SystemCondition.title: SystemCondition
SystemCondition.description: Captures snapshots of overall Q-GRID SENTINEL system conditions, telemetry averages, active threshold settings, and node health states.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user session.

conditionStatus.description: Overall smart grid security condition state.

gridWideAvgQber.description: Grid-wide average QBER percentage across all nodes.

peakQber.description: Highest QBER percentage across all nodes.

anomalyScore.description: Current TensorFlow.js Edge AI anomaly score [0.0 .. 1.0].

sensitivityPreset.description: Active AI Sentinel anomaly sensitivity preset.

automatedMitigationEnabled.description: Whether automated firewall mitigation is currently enabled.

summaryNote.description: Concise summary of the current grid telemetry condition.

clientTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string of the condition snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the condition snapshot was stored.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Collection storing all website user and system activity logs.

/triggerEvents/{triggerId}.description: Collection storing all QBER threshold breaches, attack triggers, and mitigation events.

/systemConditions/{conditionId}.description: Collection storing snapshots of overall smart grid telemetry conditions and threshold configurations.
